name: 80906 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80906 (Colorado Spgs) has 158 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80906 (Colorado Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80906 (Colorado Spgs) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
